scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Encouraging Worker's Children's Participation in Cultural Activities- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board
Applicant's monthly salary must not exceed ₹25,000
Application must be submitted within one year from the date of issue of the certificate for participation in cultural competitions
No minimum service period required for the worker
There is no limit on the number of workers' children eligible under this scheme
Benefits are provided to children of registered workers
benefits_summary: Financial assistance is provided to the children of workers for participating in or securing positions in cultural competitions, with amounts varying by competition level and type.
